scenes.text: ChatGPT can now *click around your browser* for you

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: OpenAI updated its Chrome extension on Oct 16, 2026.
Hand it your tabs. It fills forms, sends messages, downloads files.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: List one product on 5 marketplaces. It copies the listing across tabs.
Pull 20 leads from a directory into your sheet.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Give it only the tabs you'd hand an assistant. Watch the first run.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: The extension is free in the Chrome Web Store.
Usage limits follow your ChatGPT plan.

scenes.text: Would you let AI drive your browser? *Yes or no* below.
